research_scope: Demon Flash Strike — Strike Super / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.repository_history_search: Current repository search found the dedicated 2026-09-24 provenance audit and no duplicate canonical identity was introduced.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence classifies Demon Flash Strike as a Strike Super and Counter Skill; the Counter Skill taxonomy places its no-input variant under Melee Counter.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Parallel Quest 160 — Pan in Peril; current PQ reward data identifies Demon Flash Strike among the PQ160 skill rewards.
verification_audit.availability_finding: Future Warrior/CaC usable; associated with Gohan (Beast).
verification_audit.finish_policy: PQ160 reward evidence supports Basic Reward semantics; no Ultimate Finish-only gate is asserted.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: Current dedicated evidence documents a brief counter stance against melee attacks, including basic attacks, Strike Supers, Ultimates, and grabs, followed by a kick; additional input teleports forward for a punch and blue Ki Blast follow-up. The current reference reports approximately 25% counter damage and 20% follow-up damage.

records.name: Demon Flash Strike
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide explicitly lists Demon Flash Strike under PQ160 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Strike a pose that stops the opponent's melee attack; when hit, counter with a powerful kick. Additional input moves in front of the opponent to attack.
records.mechanics_notes: Counter activates against melee attacks including Normal, Supers, Ultimates and Grabs. The counter kick is documented at approximately 25% damage. Additional input teleports to the opponent, lands a punch that stuns, then slams a blue Ki Blast onto them for approximately 20% damage.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ160 is part of Hero of Justice Pack 2 content.
records.pve_notes: No unsupported drop probability was added because the available guide establishes the skill as a Basic Reward but not a percentage chance.
records.pvp_notes: Current dedicated evidence also records a historical Ver. 1.21.00 issue in which the counter kick could fail to launch the opponent; later community reports indicate the behavior was fixed. Exact current frame data and matchup-specific exceptions remain unverified.
